title: Adhyayana API Master Contracts
description: Authoritative contract-first schema registry for FastAPI backend endpoints and TypeScript frontend interfaces.

HealthCheck.title: HealthCheck
HealthCheck.description: Standard service health check probe response.

version.description: Semantic version of the running backend release.

StandardErrorResponse.title: StandardErrorResponse
StandardErrorResponse.description: Uniform error envelope returned on 4xx/5xx responses.

error_code.description: Machine-readable unique application error code (e.g., PUZZLE_SESSION_EXPIRED).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of error occurrence.

details.description: Optional contextual diagnostic data or validation failure traces.

BasePuzzleInit.title: BasePuzzleInit
BasePuzzleInit.description: Generic initialization payload for a puzzle challenge session.

metadata.description: Public configuration parameters, hints, or grid constraints.

BaseGuessRequest.title: BaseGuessRequest
BaseGuessRequest.description: Generic guess submission payload submitted by the player.

session_id.description: Active gameplay session UUID, or null if stateless.

BaseGuessResponse.title: BaseGuessResponse
BaseGuessResponse.description: Generic evaluation envelope returned by the engine evaluator.

feedback.description: Analytical qualitative feedback or hint for the learner.

is_correct.description: Boolean flag indicating if the submission resolved the puzzle.

PuzzleSession.title: PuzzleSession
PuzzleSession.description: Represents an active or completed linguistic puzzle attempt for a user.

session_id.description: Unique UUID identifier for this gameplay session.

user_id.description: Firebase Auth UID or anonymous visitor ID.

puzzle_id.description: Unique identifier of the target puzzle.

puzzle_type.description: Identifier of the mounted puzzle engine (e.g. 'contexto', 'crossword', 'word_blanks').

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the puzzle session.

attempt_count.description: Total number of valid guesses evaluated in this session.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last guess or state change.

completed_at.description: Timestamp when terminal state (WON/FAILED) was reached, or null if active.

EngineLevelContracts.title: EngineLevelContracts
EngineLevelContracts.description: Placeholder namespace for pluggable puzzle engine specific payload contracts.

PuzzleGuessRequest.title: PuzzleGuessRequest
PuzzleGuessRequest.description: Generic baseline request payload for evaluating a puzzle guess.

PuzzleGuessResponse.title: PuzzleGuessResponse
PuzzleGuessResponse.description: Generic baseline response payload returning rich pedagogical telemetry.

telemetry.description: Engine-specific analytical feedback (rank, similarity, morphological breakdown).

DifficultyLevel.title: DifficultyLevel
DifficultyLevel.description: Pedagogical difficulty tier classification for puzzle challenges.

GameType.title: GameType
GameType.description: Mechanic and engine classification for linguistic puzzles.

LearningObjective.title: LearningObjective
LearningObjective.description: Core pedagogical objective targeted by a puzzle challenge.

PuzzleLevelInfo.title: PuzzleLevelInfo
PuzzleLevelInfo.description: Progressive level descriptor with XP reward bracket and unlock state.

base_xp.description: XP rewarded upon first successful completion of this level.

unlocked_by_default.description: Whether this level is accessible immediately to guest and novice players.

PuzzleMetadata.title: PuzzleMetadata
PuzzleMetadata.description: Comprehensive catalog metadata describing a puzzle engine and its progression ladder.

short_description.description: Concise summary of gameplay mechanic and pedagogical purpose.

learning_objectives.description: List of core linguistic learning outcomes.

is_new.description: Flag highlighting newly introduced puzzle modes.

available_levels.description: Progression ladder levels available for this puzzle.

total_levels.description: Total number of progression levels configured.

max_xp.description: Cumulative total XP achievable across all levels in this puzzle.

PuzzleCatalogResponse.title: PuzzleCatalogResponse
PuzzleCatalogResponse.description: Catalog payload returning all registered puzzle engines and total count.

puzzles.description: Array of registered puzzle engines and progression metadata.

total_count.description: Total count of puzzles available in the catalog.

WordBlanksPuzzle.title: WordBlanksPuzzle
WordBlanksPuzzle.description: Individual generative stem puzzle challenge within a Word Blanks level tier.

puzzle_number.description: Sequential 1-based puzzle index within the level.

stem.description: Spaced stem representation with underscores indicating blanks (e.g. '_ A T', 'C A _', '_ R _ N _ H').

word_length.description: Total character length of the target words.

blank_count.description: Number of input blanks in the stem.

min_words_to_clear.description: Minimum count of unique valid words required to clear this puzzle and unlock stepper advance.

pedagogical_note.description: Pedagogical prompt and explanation for this specific stem pattern.

WordBlanksLevel.title: WordBlanksLevel
WordBlanksLevel.description: Progressive difficulty tier specification for Word Blanks generative recall curriculum.

title.description: Pedagogical name of this progression level (e.g. '3-Letter Onset Blanks').

description.description: Pedagogical overview and explanation for this level's lexical patterns.

xp_per_word.description: XP awarded per uniquely discovered valid English word in this level.

min_puzzles_to_unlock_next.description: Minimum count of puzzles cleared in this level to unlock the next level tier.

puzzles.description: Array of curated generative stem puzzles belonging to this level.

stem.description: Default active stem representation for backward compatibility.

DiscoveredWord.title: DiscoveredWord
DiscoveredWord.description: Pedagogical telemetry record for a successfully discovered valid word.

part_of_speech.description: Primary grammatical part of speech (noun, verb, adjective, etc.) if resolved.

definition.description: First concise Wiktionary definition returned by dictionary lookup.

xp_awarded.description: Amount of XP awarded for discovering this word.

discovered_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the word was validated.

WordBlanksGuessRequest.title: WordBlanksGuessRequest
WordBlanksGuessRequest.description: Player guess submission payload for Word Blanks level evaluation.

puzzle_number.description: 1-based index of the specific puzzle stage within the level.

entered_word.description: The complete word formed by the player filling blanks.

session_discovered.description: List of uppercase words already discovered during this session for duplicate tracking.

WordBlanksEvaluationResponse.title: WordBlanksEvaluationResponse
WordBlanksEvaluationResponse.description: Comprehensive evaluation and telemetry payload returned for a Word Blanks guess.

is_valid.description: Whether the entered word is a recognized dictionary word.

is_duplicate.description: Whether the word was already discovered during this session.

matches_pattern.description: Whether the entered word satisfies the fixed stem letter constraints.

discovered_word.description: Discovered word telemetry entry if valid and new, else null.

xp_awarded.description: XP gained from this submission (0 if duplicate or invalid).

feedback_message.description: Analytical feedback message explaining evaluation result.

GET /api/v1/puzzles.description: Retrieves the catalog of registered linguistic puzzle engines with progression levels and XP metadata.

GET /api/v1/puzzles/word-blanks/levels.description: Retrieves all 17 progressive Word Blanks levels with stem templates, nested puzzle stages, word length, blanks count, XP per word, and unlock criteria.

200.description: List of Word Blanks level specifications.

POST /api/v1/puzzles/word-blanks/evaluat.description: Validates an entered word against the level stem template, detects duplicates in current session, verifies against the dictionary, and awards XP with educational telemetry.

200.description: Word evaluated successfully with diagnostic telemetry.

400.description: Malformed request or invalid level index.

422.description: Unprocessable entity or schema validation error.
